description: Defines the interface for a cookie store in the Chromium project, including methods for setting, retrieving, deleting cookies, and managing cookie schemes and change notifications.

classes.name: net::CookieStore
classes.description: Interface for storing and retrieving cookies, with methods for cookie management and change observation.

methods.name: SetCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a canonical cookie with specified options and callback.

methods.name: GetCookieListWithOptionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cookies for a URL with specific options and partition keys.

methods.name: GetAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies for management UI.

methods.name: GetAllCookiesWithAccessSemanticsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all cookies along with their access semantics.

methods.name: DeleteAllCreatedInTimeRangeAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies created within a specified time range.

methods.name: FlushStore
methods.description: Flushes the cookie store to disk.

methods.name: SetForceKeepSessionState
methods.description: Prevents session cookies from deletion on shutdown.

methods.name: GetChangeDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the change dispatcher for observing cookie changes.

methods.name: SetCookieableSchemes
methods.description: Sets the list of schemes that can store cookies.

methods.name: SiteHasCookieInOtherPartition
methods.description: Checks if a site has cookies in other partitions.
